slides.title: 5 myths about **event networking**
slides.sub: Swipe before you write your next run sheet.
slides.scene: Phoney the blue phone character as a myth-buster in a white lab coat and safety goggles, standing in a conference networking area, slamming a giant rubber stamp down onto a towering stack of papers so that sheets fly everywhere; attendees in the background duck and stare in surprise.

slides.myth: Put networking on the agenda and people network.
slides.fact: A slot is a room booking with a hopeful label.
slides.scene: A conference meeting room with a hopeful sign on a stand showing only a heart symbol, and inside, rows of attendees all staring silently at their own phones, not talking; Phoney the blue phone character stands in the doorway, palm on face.

slides.myth: People don't network because they're shy.
slides.fact: They can't tell which stranger is worth ten of their twenty minutes.
slides.scene: A crowded conference break: a friendly attendee peers at a sea of strangers through a pair of binoculars, completely unsure who to approach, question marks floating over every head; Phoney the blue phone character sits on their shoulder scratching its head.

slides.fact: Without a real push, 20-30% of attendees download one (Nunify, 2025).
slides.scene: A big shiny app download button floats on a stand in a conference hall like a museum exhibit behind a velvet rope, and only a handful of attendees are looking at it while most walk past ignoring it; Phoney the blue phone character waves at them, slightly deflated.

slides.fact: Fewer features everyone sees beat more features a quarter of the room sees.
slides.scene: A ridiculous oversized Swiss army knife with dozens of tools sprouting out of it sits unused on a table, while beside it a single simple coffee mug is being happily used by a whole queue of attendees; Phoney the blue phone character gives a thumbs up next to the mug.

slides.myth: An attendee list is a privacy problem.
slides.fact: Ticket holders only, objectors left off, anonymous allowed, and symmetric.
slides.scene: A friendly cartoon bouncer, Phoney the blue phone character in a little black suit and earpiece, stands at a velvet rope by a guest list on a stand, letting ticket holders in with a smile while one shady stranger in a trench coat and fake moustache is politely turned away.

slides.text: Search your run sheet for "networking". We'll wait.
